messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Find duplicate entities for the item and an alias that best represents the duplicates. Duplicates are those that are the same in meaning, such as with variation in tense, plural form, stem form, case, abbreviation, shorthand. Return an empty list if there are none.

item: "inform healthcare provider about liver problems"
set: ["inform healthcare provider about liver problems", "inform healthcare provider about kidney problems", "inform healthcare provider about thyroid problems", "inform healthcare provider about Asian descent", "inform healthcare provider about all medical conditions", "inform healthcare provider about unexplained muscle aches or weakness", "healthcare provider", "inform healthcare provider about alcohol consumption more than 2 glasses daily", "inform doctor or pharmacist if have liver problems", "inform healthcare provider if pregnant or planning pregnancy", "severe liver problems", "inform healthcare provider if 65 years of age or older", "people with liver problems", "kidney or liver problems", "tell healthcare provider about all medical conditions before taking", "consult healthcare provider about best way to feed baby"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
